text: The purpose of this report is to provide an update on Purchasing and Materials Management Division's Category Management and Strategic Sourcing (CMSS) team's engagement with City Divisions, in response to direction from City Council to report on completed and planned discussions. Category Management and Strategic Sourcing work was initiated in 2021. The Category Management and Strategic Sourcing team has been fully operational without any involvement of outside consultants since June 2022 and is working collaboratively with all City Divisions. During the years 2022 and 2023, Category Management and Strategic Sourcing achieved an estimated financial benefit of $206 million in the form of a combination of cost savings and cost avoidance, through the application of a strategic approach to high value and highly complex procurements.
